name: 藕粉软底女童芭蕾舞蹈鞋款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF fields for product-only packshots and infographic panels, pale blush #F8EFE9 and cream #F6F1EA material fields for benefit and studio scenes, muted sage #DFE8DC for the one outdoor scene; every field stays clean and single-tone
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright warm-neutral studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card on the shadow side, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars, 5500K in scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale lacquer floor, soft cream fabric and matte board surfaces, warm wooden barre rail only in the studio wear scene
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, sparse label slots only, all source wording stripped and carried as blank placeholder plates
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline single-weight line icons only in the palette accent, no filled or cartoon icons
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 product angle and scale for the pair across the set; the soft sole may be shown bent once, children cropped strictly below the neck, from behind or feet only
noDrift: no identifiable child face or added characters and mascots
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium boutique dancewear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, blush upper tone #F0D6C8, apricot elastic beige #E4C6B2 and one sage accent #A9BFA8; bright warm-neutral studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, fill card and gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars; seamless white fields for product-only shots, pale blush #F8EFE9 and cream #F6F1EA material fields for benefit and studio scenes, muted sage #DFE8DC for the outdoor scene; matte pale lacquer floors and soft fabric surfaces; modern geometric sans-serif with sparse label slots only; consistent hairline thin-line icon style; clean high-end dancewear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 product angle and scale; children always cropped below the neck, from behind or feet only; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用一双两只加露底的角度讲清软底结构

shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, clean margin only around the silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One shoe standing upright at a slight 3/4 angle with its mate tipped forward on the right so the split suede under-sole patch faces the camera, both shoes fully inside the frame, photographed straight-on at eye level. Bright even high-key studio lighting from the front-left with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding both shoes. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace and no copy. 8K commercial marketplace quality. Negative: no lettering, script stamp or emblem on the sole patch, no brand marks, no third-party character marks, no hands, no props, no tinted or gradient background, no cut-off toes, no floating shoes without contact shadow, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 8 张源图逐图事实：001 白底一双两只，一正立一前翻露出麂皮分体底贴片；002 室内纸花墙前女童单腿立地舞姿；003 户外小径女童抬脚舞姿（低角度仰拍）；004 白底三格结构图（底贴片/褶皱鞋头/后跟走线）配三条英文字标；005 悬浮单鞋加羽毛与圆形内嵌手折软底；006 白底一双两只并排低角度；007 正对褶皱鞋头的近景；008 把杆旁女童穿着图加圆形脚部内嵌图。品类判定以图为准：软面交叉松紧带猫爪型舞蹈鞋、分体皮底，属鞋靴/童鞋，与源类目提示一致无错挂；情绪与身份认同驱动，故以白底主图开头、成对一致性信任镜收口。已剥离：底贴片与内底上的手写体英文字标、004 三条英文字标（改为空白标签板占位）、三张童模面容与发型（一律改写为颈部以下、背影或仅脚部）、原平台店铺字样、任何徽章与评分类角标。尺码表数值一律不入稿，规格疑虑只由结构近景与成对一致性承接。
